outcome: Admission to the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
finding: While both medically and surgically treated patients with PHPT in pregnancy showed improved maternofetal outcomes compared to earlier reports, rates of preeclampsia and preterm delivery remained higher in the medically treated group.
mod_finding: Women with PHPT in pregnancy who were treated medically had higher rates of preeclampsia and preterm delivery compared to those who underwent parathyroidectomy.
